title: tune-nccl-stream-priorities-and-scheduling-to-improve-overlap-tensor-parallel
author: Aisha Rahman
description:
Motivation: Tensor-parallel multi-GPU inference was seeing reduced comm/compute overlap on heterogeneous topologies. This PR introduces targeted NCCL stream prioritization and a lightweight scheduling layer so asynchronous collectives are launched on dedicated high-priority streams, while kernels that can safely overlap run on separate compute streams. The goal is to increase comm/compute overlap, avoid implicit kernel-syncs introduced by prior synchronization points, and provide knobs for stream priority and grouping per topology.

What this PR does:
- Adds a StreamManager that exposes priority-aware NCCL stream allocation for tensor-parallel groups. The StreamManager is topology-aware and caches per-device streams to reduce host allocation overhead.
- Introduces an NCCLScheduler that sequences collectives across low/high priority streams to maximize overlap with local kernel execution and avoids unnecessary cudaDeviceSynchronize points.
- Updates KV cache flush paths to avoid host-side synchronization during concurrent RPC-driven prefix serving when collectives are in-flight.
- Adds a lightweight kernel-queue reorder: kernels that are dependency-free are enqueued on the compute stream while collectives run on the comm stream. This removes implicit kernel syncs caused by earlier API ordering.
- Adds runtime flags and config (env and runtime config) for stream priority tuning and fallbacks for NVLink-poor topologies.
- Adds integration tests and a perf benchmark harness to measure p99 and throughput impact for long-sequence TP workloads.

Why this change: We observed 10-20% p99 regressions for long-sequence runs on some 8-GPU pods where collectives were scheduled on default streams, causing the runtime to serialize portions of compute. By separating compute and comm streams and adding a small scheduler, we preserve concurrency while still maintaining deterministic ordering for collective ops.

Risk and compatibility: The changes are guarded behind config flags; default behavior keeps current stream assignments. The scheduler falls back to legacy behavior on mixed-topology pods or when runtime detects unsupported driver versions. No API surface change to users.

Testing and results summary: Unit tests for StreamManager and NCCLScheduler added; integration test simulates a multi-node 8-GPU TP job. CI initially had a flaky integration test run (intermittent CUDA context timing) which was re-run and passed. Local bench results on internal 8xA100 machines show a 10-18% throughput improvement on long-sequence (8k) TP generation and a 8-12% reduction in p99 latency for typical conversational workloads.

Docs: Added a short doc (docs/ops/nccl_tuning.md) describing knobs and recommended profiles for common topologies.

References: ENG-4512 (TP compute/comm regressions), SUP-1284 (customer report on 8-GPU pod latency), related PRs: pr-26432, pr-25210.

review_comments: Carlos Gomez: Please add a fallback path for mixed NVLink/non-NVLink topologies; we saw hangs in staging when collectives used high-priority streams on a mixed cluster.

Aisha Rahman: Added topology detection and a conservative fallback that pins collectives to legacy streams on mixed clusters (see nccl_scheduler.h), and added a perf/regression test to cover the fallback path.
Maya Patel: Can you add metrics for comm stream occupancy and kernel overlap time? We need observability to tune defaults.

Aisha Rahman: Added two perf counters (runtime.tp.comm_stream_overlap_ms and runtime.tp.compute_stream_active_ms) emitted when perf mode is enabled; documented the counters in docs/ops/nccl_tuning.md.
Ethan Li: Integration test failed first CI due to a timing race in test harness; reworked the harness to wait on a readiness barrier before starting the workload.
Aisha Rahman: Re-ran CI after harness fix; integration tests passed and perf suite shows improvements listed in description.
perf_summary: Internal bench on 8xA100 (NVLink full mesh): 10-18% throughput improvement on 8k sequence TP workloads; 8-12% p99 latency reduction on conversational workloads. Improvements smaller (~3-6%) on NVLink-poor topologies with fallback enabled.
release_notes: Improved multi-GPU tensor-parallel performance: added priority-aware NCCL stream scheduling and topology-aware fallbacks to increase comm/compute overlap and reduce p99 latency for TP workloads.
notes: Default behavior unchanged; enabled via runtime config flag 'tp.nccl_stream_priorities = true'. If customers see issues, they can disable the flag or set 'tp.nccl_stream_mode=legacy'.
